paper.title_en: The antibaryon-baryon interaction based on chiral EFT with a focus on $\bar pp$ and $\barΛΛ$ reactions
paper.abstract_en: The antibaryon-baryon ($\bar BB$) interaction is reviewed in the context of the hyperon(Y)-production reactions $\bar NN\to\bar YY$ with special emphasis on the $\bar ΛΛ$ system. The experimental situation for $\bar BB\to\bar YY$ from threshold up to antiproton lab momenta of $2$ GeV/c is discussed and likewise past theoretical approaches and results. The formalism for a description of the $\bar BB$ interaction in terms of potentials derived within SU(3) chiral effective field theory (EFT) is outlined. Constraints from SU(3) flavor symmetry on the $\bar BB$ interaction in the various reaction channels are discussed. As concrete application a new analysis of the reaction $\bar pp\to\bar ΛΛ$ is performed utilizing potentials for the $\bar NN$ and $\bar ΛΛ$ channels, and for the $\bar NN\to\barΛΛ$ transition, up to next-to-leading order in the chiral expansion, supplemented by a phenomenological part to account for annihilation processes. An excellent reproduction of data from the PS185 experiment at CERN up to momenta of $1.55$ GeV/c is achieved. When including higher-order contact terms in the analysis the range of agreement can be extended up to momenta around $1.65$ GeV/c, where a complete set of scattering observables is available. Predictions for $\barΛΛ$ scattering are provided and compared to results from the literature.
